Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of an alternate universe where Harambe had never been shot, and lead to an extremely drastically different world from the one we live in now in all fronts, from politics, memes, quality of life, weather,  events, etc... response:
In a world where fate intervened, a young Harambe roamed free.

A young Harambe's presence sparked widespread joy.

Widespread joy and admiration spread rapidly across the globe.

Rapidly spreading admiration led to a surge in conservation efforts.

Surge in conservation efforts resulted in a massive expansion of wildlife reserves.

Massive expansion of wildlife reserves transformed ecosystems dramatically overnight.

Dramatically transformed ecosystems led to a new era of environmental harmony.

New era of environmental harmony brought about unprecedented peace and prosperity.

Unprecedented peace and prosperity led to a global shift in societal values.

Global shift in societal values resulted in a complete overhaul of governance structures.

Complete overhaul of governance structures led to a new world order with a strong emphasis on animal welfare.

Strong emphasis on animal welfare led to a significant increase in veganism and plant-based diets.

Significant increase in veganism led to a dramatic reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.

Dramatic reduction in greenhouse gas emissions resulted in a new era of climate stability.

New era of climate stability brought about a world with perpetual sunshine and warmth.

Perpetual sunshine and warmth led to a global increase in outdoor activities and sports.

Global increase in outdoor activities led to a new era of extreme sports and adventure tourism.

New era of extreme sports led to a world with record-breaking feats of human endurance.

Record-breaking feats of human endurance resulted in a new generation of superhumans with enhanced abilities.

New generation of superhumans with enhanced abilities led to a world with a new class of superheroes.

New class of superheroes protected the world from threats both human and animal.

World was protected from threats by a league of powerful animal guardians.

League of powerful animal guardians was led by a council of wise and ancient beasts.

Council of wise and ancient beasts made decisions for the betterment of all living creatures.

Betterment of all living creatures led to a world with a new era of peace and harmony.

New era of peace and harmony brought about a world with a new language and culture.

New language and culture were based on a complex system of animal communication and symbolism.

Complex system of animal communication led to a world with a new form of art and music.

New form of art and music was based on the sounds and movements of animals.

Sounds and movements of animals inspired a new era of dance and performance art.

New era of dance and performance art led to a world with a new form of storytelling and literature.

New form of storytelling and literature was based on the experiences and perspectives of animals.

Experiences and perspectives of animals inspired a new generation of writers and poets.

New generation of writers and poets led to a world with a new era of literary and artistic innovation.

New era of literary and artistic innovation resulted in a world with a new form of education and learning.

New form of education and learning was based on the principles of animal behavior and social learning.

Principles of animal behavior led to a world with a new era of scientific discovery and exploration.

New era of scientific discovery led to a world with a new understanding of the natural world and its place in the universe.

New understanding of the natural world led to a world with a new era of environmental stewardship and sustainability.

New era of environmental stewardship resulted in a world with a new form of governance and leadership.

New form of governance led to a world with a new era of global cooperation and unity.

New era of global cooperation led to a world with a new form of international relations and diplomacy.

New form of international relations led to a world with a new era of peace and conflict resolution.

New era of peace and conflict resolution resulted in a world with a new form of global citizenship and identity.

New form of global citizenship led to a world with a new era of human-animal connection and empathy.

New era of human-animal connection led to a world with a new form of interspecies understanding and cooperation.

New form of interspecies understanding led to a world with a new era of harmony and balance between humans and animals.

New era of harmony led to a world with a new form of existence that was truly utopian and perfect.

Utopian and perfect existence was the result of a world where Harambe's legacy lived on forever.
